item.tib: gdugs dkar zlog chen gyi bca' thabs lag len gsal byed me long
item.coloph: kun grol grags pa zhes gdugs dkar zlog chen bca' thabs dang / rdzas kyi ngos 'dzin 'di ni/ khro khyung nang so g.yung drung nam mkha' dbang ldan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ lham bu pa kun grol grags pas khro chen rgyal po'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal 'brug mo rdzong gi lha khang btsam (du brtsams) pa shing byi hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i dkar phyogs su dge'o//
